description.value: Marina Bay Cafe is a Deaf-owned and operated specialty cafe perched on the scenic Esquimalt waterfront in Victoria, offering a creative menu of espresso drinks, tea lattes, smoothies, and toasties sourced from local suppliers including Fernwood Coffee. The cafe was featured on CHEK News for its community story, and staff are encouraged to learn American Sign Language, making it a notably inclusive stop on Victoria's waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 47m; rack at 64m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Marina Bay Cafe is live and fully corroborates the OSM record: address (108 - 474 Head Street, Victoria, BC V9A 5S2), phone (236-471-5302), and business type (cafe). The website confirms active operation with a full menu, career listings dated 2026, and an About Us page describing a Deaf-owned waterfront cafe featured on CHEK News. No bike-specific amenities (racks, wi-fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags beyond outdoor_seating=yes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible cafe on the Victoria waterfront with a fully active website, confirmed contact details, and current menu and staffing pages.
